title: FramedBlocks Unofficial Fabric
description: Unofficial partial Fabric port of FramedBlocks
body:
# FramedBlocks Fabric Port

**Unofficial partial Fabric port of FramedBlocks for Minecraft 26.1.2.**

This mod adds framed building blocks that can visually copy the appearance of other blocks.

> **Important:** this is **not** the official FramedBlocks mod.
> Original FramedBlocks is created by **XFactHD**. This project is an unofficial, partial port made for Fabric

## Features

* Selected FramedBlocks-style blocks only
* Camo/framing behavior for supported blocks
* Tools for editing framed blocks:

  * Framed Hammer
  * Framed Wrench
  * Framed Screwdriver
  * Framed Key

## Included Content

This is **not a full port** of FramedBlocks.

![content](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c0eeae89d0dcc9a5ddc687f6ac56aa07eadb2db.png)

## Not Included

Many blocks and features from the original FramedBlocks are currently missing.

This port is focused on the selected blocks above, mainly for Fabric 26.1.2 compatibility.

## Credits

Original FramedBlocks mod by **XFactHD**.

This project is based on the idea and behavior of FramedBlocks, but it is an unofficial partial Fabric port.
